vertex_allocation_fix.problem: The minimum expansion limit of the two endpoints of a lateral corridor connector pins its movable internal endpoint to the fixed physical-edge endpoint. Smaller later requests also overwrote shared-vertex swept-width requests.
vertex_allocation_fix.correction: Allocate desired width using available endpoint limits, cap every vertex by its own proven road/object limit, and retain the maximum request across adjacent path samples. Final smoothing still reapplies all per-vertex limits.
vertex_allocation_fix.comparison_note: Snapshots are 0.477 m apart in ego position with different traffic phases; this is a geometry inspection, not a controlled timing benchmark.
